setupEn: {{pat}}, an office worker, moves into a new apartment. The one who brings the neighborhood notice around is {{docFull}}, a married woman who always seems to be home alone.
story: 最初は「ご近所付き合いだから」と作りすぎた料理を分けてくれるだけだった{{doc}}さん。
顔を合わせるたびに話が長くなり、部屋に上げてくれ、指輪をはずした手を見せるように。
「うち、旦那が帰ってこないの」――その一言から、玄関先の会話が変わっていく。
30日目、誰もいない部屋で、ふたりの関係が変わる。
storyEn: At first, {{doc}} just shares the food she made too much of, because that's what neighbors do.
Each time they meet, the talk gets longer. She invites him in. She lets him see her hand without the ring.
"My husband doesn't come home anymore." After that, the doorway conversations change.
On Day 30, in an empty apartment, everything changes.
